motion.visual: Basalt platform 3x3 on a steam column at the cliff foot. Collider = a 3x4x3 box whose top is the platform: offset 0 = top flush with the basin felt (y 0, box y -4..0, sunk in a shaft), offset 4 = top flush with the upper green (y 4). Profile: pause DOWN 8 s (boarding window, steam simmering) -> rise 4 at 2 studs/s -> pause UP 1.5 s (big puff + whistle) -> sink 4 at 2 studs/s.

Ice floe slab 7 long, 0.6 thick, 1.0 tall with pointed 45-degree ends, gliding on a hidden track across the neck; blocking = centred on the neck (offset 0), parked = drifted 7 west into a pocket in the snowbank
4 broad timber paddles (width 2.4, radius 0.6..4.1, tips clipped to a circle, built from 6 strips each); axle y=4.16; lowest paddle edge 0.06 over the felt
Carousel sweep: 4 low sled-runner arms (r 8.2..11.5, 3.6 wide, 0.9 tall), each carrying a snowpuff on a little sled above the collider, sweeping round the hub at 15 deg/s

Aurora ribbon span 3 x 8 (Neon, animated mint->violet gradient) between the crystal piers. Cycle 9 s from t=0: FADE IN 0.6 s (Transparency 1 -> 0, CanCollide false) -> SOLID 6 s (Transparency 0, CanCollide TRUE) -> FADE OUT 0.6 s (0 -> 0.85, CanCollide false) -> GONE 1.8 s (Transparency 1, CanCollide false). The collider exists ONLY in the solid window [0.6, 6.6) s; a ball on it when it switches off falls into the gap (+1, respawn at the light-route entry).
